idioms.meaning_en: weed through the old to bring forth the new
fly one's own unique banner; develop an original unique style
possess ingenious and unique artistic originality
display new and distinctive originality; pioneer trends

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 仓/倉 (storehouse of ideas) + 刂 (knife carving out original form)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Carving 刂 out an unprecedented path from a storehouse 仓 of wisdom; creating or originating something brand-new.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A sharp chisel knife (刂) carving a storehouse (仓) of raw ideas into an unprecedented creation (创).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un cincel afilado (刂) que labra el almacén (仓) de ideas dando a luz una creación inédita (创).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 亲/𣐀 (young green tree twigs) + 斤 (axe felling fresh timber)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Using an axe 斤 to fell fresh fragrant green timber 亲 in the forest; symbolizes freshness, renewal, and beginning anew.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An axe (斤) cutting down aromatic fresh cedar branches (亲) welcomes the new (新).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El hacha (斤) talando ramas verdes y lozanas (亲) evoca la fragante novedad de lo recién nacido (新).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在当今科技变革一日千里的时代，创新是企业赖以生存和基业长青的永恒灵魂。墨守成规、故步自封的企业终将被汹涌的市场浪潮无情淘汰；唯有勇于打破惯性思维、敢于试错探索，才能在无人区中开辟出崭新的发展蓝海。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dāngjīn kējì biàngé yīrì-qiānlǐ de shídài, chuàngxīn shì qǐyè làiyǐ shēngcún hé jīyè-chángqīng de yǒnghéng línghún. Mòshǒu-chéngguī, gùbù-zìfēng de qǐyè zhōng jiāng bèi xiōngyǒng de shìchǎng làngcháo wúqíng táotài; wéiyǒu yǒngyú dǎpò guànxìng sīwéi, gǎnyú shìcuò tànsuǒ, cáinéng zài wúrénqū zhōng kāipì chū zhǎnxīn de fāzhǎn lánhǎi.
extended_reading_passages.en: In rapid tech change, innovation is the eternal soul for corporate survival. Businesses clinging to conventions will be weeded out by markets; only those daring to shatter inertia and experiment can open fresh blue oceans in unchartered territory.
extended_reading_passages.es: En tiempos de vertiginoso cambio técnico, la innovación es el alma de la longevidad corporativa. Quien se atrinchere en viejas fórmulas será barrido por el mercado; solo arriesgando e innovando se descubren nuevos océanos de oportunidad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 推进国家治理体系和治理能力现代化，必须高度重视制度创新与技术创新的双轮驱动。将前沿数字通信、大数据算法与政务便民服务紧密结合，不仅打破了部门之间长期存在的“数据孤岛”，更为广大民众提供了高效普惠的智慧公共服务。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tuījìn guójiā zhìlǐ tǐxì yǔ zhìlǐ nénglì xiàndàihuà, bìxū gāodù zhòngshì zhìdù chuàngxīn yǔ jìshù chuàngxīn de shuānglún qūdòng. Jiāng qiányán shùzì tōngxìn, dàshùjù suànfǎ yǔ zhèngwù biànmín fúwù jǐnmì jiéhé, bùjǐn dǎpòle bùmén zhījiān chángqī cúnzài de 'shùjù gūdǎo', gèng wèi guǎngdà mínzhòng tígōngle gāoxiào pǔhuì de zhìhuì gōnggòng fúwù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Modernizing national governance demands equal attention to institutional and tech innovation. Fusing communications, big data, and public services breaks departmental data silos, delivering smart and inclusive public services for all.
extended_reading_passages.es: Modernizar la gobernanza nacional exige aunar innovación institucional y técnica. Vincular telecomunicaciones, algoritmos de datos y atención ciudadana derriba silos burocráticos brindando servicios públicos inteligentes a la población.

meanings_summary.en: to lead; guide; leader; leadership; management
meanings_summary.es: liderar; dirigir; guiar; líder; dirigente; jefatura; liderazgo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Turning one's neck at the head of the vanguard (领) and guiding the road with a steady hand (导) is leading (领导).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Encabezar la comitiva al frente (领) señalando la senda con la mano (导) es liderar o dirigir (领导).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originates from tailoring collars and coats (提纲挈领): grasping the main collar (领) to align the entire garment effortlessly; executive leadership.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two third tones in succession: 'lǐng dǎo' transforms via tone sandhi into (35-214). Pronounce 'líng dǎo'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 领导 can refer to the overarching leadership role, or to the specific executive officials heading an organization.

contrasts.analysis: 指导 focuses on providing technical advice, academic tutoring, or tactical pointers ('学术指导', '教练指导'), without commanding organizational administrative power like 领导.
管理 emphasizes daily operations, workflow regulation, resource logistics, and rules ('时间管理', '企业管理'), whereas 领导 inspires strategic vision and steers goals.
首领 refers to tribal chiefs, rebel leaders, or underworld syndicates, while 领导 is standard for legitimate civil/corporate leadership.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has mound radical 阝 on right of 令 instead of 页 in 领
Has ice radical 冫 on left of 令
Has 廾 at bottom instead of 寸 in 导
Has 双-like top over 寸

senses.definition_en: to guide, direct, command, or head an organization, team, or political movement toward a goal
senses.definition_es: guiar, dirigir, encabezar o mandar un equipo, organismo o nación hacia una meta

senses.definition_en: a person who holds a managerial or leadership post; superiors in office
senses.definition_es: persona que ostenta un cargo directivo; superior jerárquico o dirigente

example_sentences.hanzi: 在杰出企业领导团队的远见卓识指引下，微信成功从一款国内即时通讯软件蜕变为享誉全球的超级应用。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài jiéchū qǐyè lǐngdǎo tuánduì de yuǎnjiàn-zhuóshí zhǐyǐn xià, Wēixìn chénggōng cóng yī kuǎn guónèi jíshí tōngxùn ruǎnjiàn tuìbiàn wéi xiǎngyù quánqiú de chāojí yìngyòng.
example_sentences.en: Guided by the foresight of its outstanding corporate leadership team, WeChat successfully metamorphosed from a domestic chat app into a globally acclaimed super-app.
example_sentences.es: Guiado por la visión de su cúpula directiva, WeChat evolucionó de un chat doméstico a una súper-aplicación aclamada en el mundo entero.

example_sentences.hanzi: 一位真正优秀的领导者不仅要懂得指挥调度，更要懂得倾听一线基层员工的真实诉求与创新想法。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yī wèi zhēnzhèng yōuxiù de lǐngdǎozhě bùjǐn yào dǒngde zhǐhuī diàodù, gèng yào dǒngde qīngtīng yīxiàn jīcéng yuángōng de zhēnshí sùqiú yǔ chuàngxīn xiǎngfǎ.
example_sentences.en: A truly great leader must not only know how to command, but equally know how to listen to frontline staff's genuine needs and creative thoughts.
example_sentences.es: Un auténtico líder no solo sabe impartir directrices, sino que escucha con atención las inquietudes y propuestas de los empleados de base.

idioms.meaning_en: take the lead and set a fine example for others
charge at the head of one's troops; lead from the front
a host of dragons without a head; leaderless group in chaos
subordinates follow the example set by superiors

character_decomposition.meaning_es: cuello; cuello de ropa; liderar; guiar; percibir
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 令 (command / order) + 页 (human head / neck)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: The neck or collar 页 beneath the head that directs where the body turns, following orders 令; taking the lead.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Turning the head and neck (页) to issue authoritative guidance orders (令) leads the crowd (领).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El cuello de la cabeza (页) que gira al dictar órdenes firmes (令) encabeza la marcha (领).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 巳/道 (pathway of truth) + 寸 (guiding hand)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A hand 寸 holding a lamp or staff to point out the proper roadway 道; guiding, channeling water, and leading followers safely.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A steady hand (寸) pointing out the correct route along the road guides the way (导).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano prudente (寸) que señala la calzada correcta encauzando a los caminantes (导).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在波谲云诡的商业市场大变局中，优秀的领导者最核心的品质是临危不乱的战略定力。领导团队必须能够在迷雾中洞见未来的发展大势，凝聚全体员工的信念与力量，带领整个企业化被动为主动、化危机为转机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài bōjué-yúnguǐ de shāngyè shìchǎng dàbiànjú zhōng, yōuxiù de lǐngdǎozhě zuì héxīn de pǐnzhì shì línwéi-búlùan de zhànlüè dìnglì. Lǐngdǎo tuánduì bìxū nénggòu zài míwù zhōng dòngjiàn wèilái de fāzhǎn dàshì, níngjù quántǐ yuángōng de xìnniàn yǔ lìliang, dàilǐng zhěnggè qǐyè huà bèidòng wéi zhǔdòng, huà wēijī wéi zhuǎnjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid market upheavals, a great leader's core trait is calm strategic resolve. A leadership team must discern future trends through the fog, rallying employee conviction to turn passive stances into initiative and crises into turning points.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante la volatilidad del mercado, la mayor virtud de un líder es el aplomo estratégico. La directiva debe otear el porvenir entre la niebla uniendo la fuerza del equipo para trocar la adversidad en oportunidad de éxito.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 领导干部应当始终把人民群众的安危冷暖放在心中最高位置。真正深入基层调查研究，倾听百姓在医疗、教育与养老方面的操心事与烦心事，以实干担当的精神为老百姓排忧解难，才能赢得广大人民群众由衷的信赖与拥护。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lǐngdǎo gànbù yīngdāng shǐzhōng bǎ rénmín qúnzhòng de ānwēi lěngnuǎn fàng zài xīnzhōng zuìgāo wèizhì. Zhēnzhèng shēnrù jīcéng diàochá yánjiū, qīngtīng bǎixìng zài yīliáo, jiàoyù yǔ yǎnglǎo fāngmiàn de cāoxīnshì yǔ fánxīnshì, yǐ shígàn dāndāng de jīngshén wèi lǎobǎixìng páiyōu-jiěnán, cáinéng yíngdé guǎngdà rénmín qúnzhòng yóuzhōng de xìnlài yǔ yōnghù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Leading cadres must always hold the people's welfare in the highest esteem. Deeply surveying the grassroots to listen to everyday concerns in healthcare and education, and solving hardships with pragmatic work wins the people's heartfelt trust.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los dirigentes deben priorizar el bienestar popular por encima de todo. Pisando el terreno para atender desvelos en sanidad, educación y jubilación, su entrega sincera a la ciudadanía les granjea el respaldo y cariño del pueblo.

meanings_summary.en: status; position; standing; rank; social stature
meanings_summary.es: estatus; posición; rango; condición social; lugar de honor

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The plot of earth (地) upon which a person stands erect (位) defines their social status and position (地位).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El suelo firme (地) sobre el que la persona se alza erguida (位) define su estatus o posición (地位).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical court feudal protocol: each nobleman assigned a precise mat and geographic territory according to ancestral rank (席位、爵位).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two falling fourth tones: 'dì wèi' (51-51). Pronounce both syllables with firm, crisp falling pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 地位 describes relative social stature, political prestige, or systemic weight within an industry or hierarchy.

contrasts.analysis: 位置 primarily refers to physical, geographical coordinates or physical seats ('地理位置', '坐在我的位置上'), whereas 地位 refers to social prestige or relative standing.
身份 emphasizes individual legal/social identity, membership, or pedigree ('公民身份', '学者身份'), while 地位 measures level of prestige and power.
职位 is a specific corporate/administrative job title (e.g. manager, accountant), while 地位 is broader stature.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has water radical 氵 on left of 也 instead of earth 土 in 地
Has person radical 亻 on left of 也
Has hand radical 扌 on left of 立 instead of 亻 in 位
Has water radical 氵 on left of 立

senses.definition_en: social standing, official rank, or relative prestige enjoyed by a person, group, or nation in society
senses.definition_es: estatus, rango o posición relativa de consideración que ocupa una persona, entidad o país en la sociedad

senses.definition_en: the relative importance, weight, or significance held by an entity or subject in a system
senses.definition_es: relevancia, peso o función primordial que ostenta algo dentro de un sistema o ámbito

example_sentences.hanzi: 凭借庞大的用户基数与创新的移动生态，微信牢固确立了在全球移动互联网社交领域的领先地位。
example_sentences.pinyin: Píngjiè pángdà de yònghù jīshù yǔ chuàngxīn de yídòng shēngtài, Wēixìn láogù quèlìle zài quánqiú yídòng hùliánwǎng shèjiāo lǐngyù de lǐngxiān dìwèi.
example_sentences.en: Relying on its massive user base and innovative mobile ecosystem, WeChat firmly established its leading status in global mobile internet social networking.
example_sentences.es: Gracias a su ingente base de usuarios y su ecosistema móvil, WeChat afianzó una posición de liderazgo en las redes sociales del mundo.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在新中国妇女解放运动的推动下，女性在政治、经济与文化生活中的社会地位得到了历史性的显著提升。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài Xīn Zhōngguó fùnǚ jiěfàng yùndòng de tuīdòng xià, nǚxìng zài zhèngzhì, jīngjì yǔ wénhuà shēnghuó zhōng de shèhuì dìwèi dédàole lìshǐxìng de xiǎnzhù tíshēng.
example_sentences.en: Propelled by women's liberation in New China, women's social status in political, economic, and cultural life witnessed historic and remarkable elevation.
example_sentences.es: Impulsado por el movimiento de emancipación femenina, el estatus social de la mujer en la política y la cultura experimentó un salto histórico.

idioms.meaning_en: hold decisive weight; play a pivotal role
unshakeable; rock-solid in standing
rank among the very top of lists
settle down and establish one's life position securely

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 土 (fertile soil/earth) + 也 (female vessel / yielding expanse of terrain)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Mounds of fertile soil 土 stretching across the yielding receptive expanse 也 of Mother Earth; physical terrain, place, and grounding.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Mounds of rich soil (土) stretching across the vast landscape (也) form the supportive earth (地).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Montículos de tierra fértil (土) extendidos por el llano (也) componen el suelo sobre el que nos afirmamos (地).

character_decomposition.meaning_en: position; place; seat; polite classifier for people
character_decomposition.meaning_es: posición; lugar; asiento; rango; clasificador de personas
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 亻 (person / human standing) + 立 (stand erect on earth)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A person 亻 standing erect 立 in their appointed formal post or seat at ancestral court; assigned place and rank.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A dignified person (亻) standing proudly (立) occupies their rightful seat and post (位).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona distinguida (亻) que se alza erguida (立) en su escaño legítimo (位).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在激烈的全球半导体产业链竞争中，光刻机制造技术占据着举足轻重的基石地位。任何一家科技企业要想在全球供应链中拥有话语权，就必须牢牢掌握关键核心技术，巩固不可替代的产业地位，方能立于不败之地。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài jīliè de quánqiú bàndǎotǐ chǎnyèliàn jìngzhēng zhōng, guāngkèjī zhìzào jìshù zhànjù zhe jǔzú-qīngzhòng de jīshí dìwèi. Rènhé yī jiā kējì qǐyè yào xiǎng zài quánqiú gōngyìngliàn zhōng yǒngyǒu huàyǔquán, jiù bìxū láoláo zhǎngwò guānjiàn héxīn jìshù, gǒnggù bùkě-tìdài de chǎnyè dìwèi, fāng néng lìyú búbài zhī dì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In semiconductor competition, photolithography manufacturing occupies a pivotal cornerstone position. For any tech enterprise to wield a voice in the global supply chain, it must master core technologies to consolidate an irreplaceable standing.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la pugna de semiconductores, la litografía ostenta un peso estratégico decisivo. Toda tecnológica que aspire a influir en la cadena de suministros debe dominar tecnologías críticas para blindar una posición industrial insustituible.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国作为联合国安理会常任理事国，在维护世界和平与推动全球可持续发展方面发挥着不可替代的关键作用。通过积极参与国际维和行动与全球气候治理谈判，中国的国际地位与大国影响力与日俱增，赢得了国际社会的普遍赞誉。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó zuòwéi Liánhéguó Ānlǐhuì chángrèn lǐshìguó, zài wéihù shìjiè hépíng yǔ tuīdòng quánqiú kěchíxù fāzhǎn fāngmiàn fāhuī zhe bùkě-tìdài de guānjiàn zuòyòng. Tōngguò jījí cānyù guójì wéihé xíngdòng yǔ quánqiú qìhòu zhìlǐ tánpàn, Zhōngguó de guójì dìwèi yǔ dàguó yǐngxiǎnglì yǔrì-jùzēng, yíngdéle guójì shèhuì de pǔbiàn zànyù.
extended_reading_passages.en: As a permanent member of the UN Security Council, China plays an irreplaceable role in world peace and sustainable development. By engaging in peacekeeping and climate negotiations, China's international status and influence steadily climb, earning global acclaim.
extended_reading_passages.es: Como miembro permanente del Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, China desempeña un papel clave en la paz y el desarrollo mundial. Participando en misiones de paz y cumbres climáticas, su estatura internacional e influencia crecen cosechando estima global.

meanings_summary.en: to manage; operate; run (business, shop); orchestrate; deliberate
meanings_summary.es: gestionar; administrar; regentar; dirigir un negocio; cultivar esmeradamente

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Weaving the strategic warp threads (经) around a thriving commercial encampment (营) is business management (经营).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Ordenar los hilos de la urdimbre (经) dentro del campamento de operaciones (营) es gestionar o regentar (经营).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical planning (经之营之，不日成之 in the Book of Songs): surveying land, laying foundations, and running institutions to completion.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone followed by second tone: 'jīng yíng' (55-35). Hold high pitch 55, then glide up smoothly to 35.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 经营 emphasizes commercial decision-making, running shops/enterprises, or cultivating relationships with devoted care.

contrasts.analysis: 管理 focuses on internal administrative regulation, employee oversight, and operational order ('行政管理'), while 经营 focuses on external market strategy, profit, and commercial enterprise ('经营理念').
运营 highlights the functional, technical, or day-to-day ongoing running of a railway, app, or system ('地铁运营', '用户运营'), while 经营 is broader commercial governance.
营业 refers simply to opening doors for business hours and sales during the day ('正常营业', '营业时间').

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has step radical 彳 on left instead of silk 纟 in 经
Has grass radical 艹 on top of 𢀖
Has fire 火 at bottom instead of 吕 in 营
Has jade 玉 at bottom

senses.definition_en: to organize, operate, and manage a commercial business, retail store, enterprise, or agricultural farm for revenue
senses.definition_es: organizar, dirigir y administrar una empresa, tienda o explotación agraria con fines económicos
senses.example_phrase: 经营商铺 (operate a shop / retail store)

senses.definition_en: to nurture, cultivate, and build up a relationship, family, or personal career with meticulous care
senses.definition_es: cultivar, cuidar y fomentar una relación afectiva, hogar o trayectoria con esmero continuo
senses.example_phrase: 用心经营生活 (manage / cultivate life with care)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在海外多个新兴市场，腾讯秉持本地化经营理念，雇佣当地优秀人才负责日常社群运营与品牌拓展。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài hǎiwài duō gè xīnxīng shìchǎng, Téngxùn bǐngchí běndìhuà jīngyíng lǐniàn, gùyōng dāngdì yōuxiù réncái fùzé rìcháng shèqún yùnyíng yǔ pǐnpái tuòzhǎn.
example_sentences.en: Across emerging overseas markets, Tencent upholds a localized management philosophy, hiring outstanding local talents to oversee community operations and brand expansion.
example_sentences.es: En mercados emergentes, Tencent aplica una filosofía de gestión localizada, contratando talento local para coordinar la comunidad y la marca.

example_sentences.hanzi: 老夫妻俩在古城巷弄里精心经营着一家传统手工艺茶馆，几十年如一日的热情招待赢得了四方茶客的赞誉。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǎo fūqī liǎ zài gǔchéng xiàngnòng lǐ jīngxīn jīngyíng zhe yī jiā chuántǒng shǒugōngyì cháguǎn, jǐshí nián rùyīrì de rèqíng zhāodài yíngdéle sìfāng chákè de zànyù.
example_sentences.en: The elderly couple meticulously managed a traditional artisanal teahouse in the ancient alleyway, winning travelers' acclaim with warm hospitality for decades.
example_sentences.es: La anciana pareja regenta con mimo una tetería artesanal en el casco antiguo, cosechando elogios con su hospitalidad entrañable a lo largo de décadas.

idioms.meaning_en: work painstakingly under difficult circumstances to build something up
manage and build up through painstaking labor and deep dedication
shrewd, capable, and efficient in business management
bring in bushels of gold daily; highly lucrative business

character_decomposition.meaning_en: warp thread; pass through; classics; manage
character_decomposition.meaning_es: urdimbre; hilo longitudinal; pasar por; clásicos; regir
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 纟 (longitudinal silk warp threads on loom) + 𢀖/巠 (flowing water veins)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: The vertical warp threads 纟 anchored on a weaving loom through which the shuttle passes; organizing, regulating, and planning an enterprise.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Guiding silk threads (纟) along straight continuous loom tracks plans the whole fabric (经).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Tensar los hilos de seda (纟) a lo largo del telar para ordenar el tejido del negocio (经).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 艹/𤇾 (surrounding boundary / twin signal torches) + 吕/宫 (encircled tents and living chambers)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Encircling wooden palisades with watchfires at night around living quarters 吕; organizing military camps, constructing, and managing operations.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Guarding torchlights over interconnected barracks encampments (营) to manage troop affairs securely.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Lumbres de vigía sobre las estancias del campamento (营) para organizar con celo la plaza.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在市场竞争日趋白热化的互联网时代，企业唯有恪守诚信经营的道德底线，才能在消费者心中树立牢固的品牌丰碑。任何依靠虚假夸大宣传或侵害用户隐私牟取短期暴利的违规行为，终将在法治与市场的双重审判下自食恶果。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài shìchǎng jìngzhēng rìqū báirèhuà de hùliánwǎng shídài, qǐyè wéiyǒu kèshǒu chéngxìn jīngyíng de dàodé dǐxiàn, cáinéng zài xiāofèizhě xīnzhōng shùlì láogù de pǐnpái fēngbēi. Rènhé yīkào xūjiǎ kuādà xuānchuán huò qīnhài yònghù yǐnsī móuqǔ duǎnqī bàolì de wéiguī xíngwéi, zhōng jiàng zài fǎzhì yǔ shìchǎng de shuāngzhòng shěnpàn xià zìshí-èguiǒ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid cutthroat competition, enterprises must adhere to honest management to erect an enduring brand monument. Unlawful behavior relying on false advertising or privacy infringement for fast windfalls will inevitably face severe punishment.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la feroz competencia digital, las empresas deben ceñirse a una gestión honesta para ganarse el aprecio del público. Lucrarse con publicidad engañosa o violar la intimidad acarrea el reproche inexorable de la ley y del mercado.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 家庭幸福与真挚友谊同样需要双方倾注心血去悉心经营。生活中难免会经历风雨坎坷与琐碎摩擦，懂得包容谅解、经常保持真诚深度的沟通，才能让爱的暖流在平凡的岁月长河中历久弥新，构筑起抵御一切外界风浪的温馨港湾。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jiātíng xìngfú yǔ zhēnzhì yǒuyì tóngyàng xūyào shuāngfāng qīngzhù xīnxuè qù xīxīn jīngyíng. Shēnghuó zhōng nánmiǎn huì jīnglì fēngyǔ kǎnkě yǔ suǒsuì mócā, dǒngde bāoróng liàngjiě, chángcháng bǎochí zhēnchéng shēndù de gōutōng, cáinéng ràng ài de nuǎnliú zài píngfán de suìyuè chánghé zhōng lìjiǔ-míxīn, gòuzhù qǐ dǐyù yīqiè wàijiè fēnglàng de wēnxīn gǎngwān.
extended_reading_passages.en: Family bliss and sincere friendship similarly demand devoted care to cultivate. Life inevitably encounters friction; practicing forgiveness and honest communication keeps the warmth of love enduring, building a cozy haven against all storms.
extended_reading_passages.es: La dicha familiar y la amistad entrañable exigen cultivarse con esmero constante. En la vida surgen fricciones; la comprensión y el diálogo sincero avivan el cariño construyendo un puerto seguro frente a cualquier temporal.

meanings_summary.en: to sell; market; sales; commercial merchandising
meanings_summary.es: vender; comercializar; ventas; expedición y enajenación de mercancías

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Flowing metal coins briskly in trade (销) while shouting prices in the market (售) is selling goods (销售).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Hacer circular monedas de metal (销) mientras se vocea el género en la plaza (售) es vender (销售).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Metaphorical blend: goods flying off shelves so fast they seem to dissolve like melted gold (销) matched with bargaining at trading posts (售).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone followed by fourth tone: 'xiāo shòu' (55-51). Hold high pitch 55, then execute a sharp decisive fall to 51.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 销售 emphasizes the formal, structured business operations, channels, and transactions of selling products or services.

contrasts.analysis: 卖 is colloquial and everyday for any act of selling ('卖苹果', '卖菜'), while 销售 is a formal commercial term used for corporate distribution, sales volume, and marketing strategy.
营销 (marketing) encompasses market research, brand building, pricing strategy, and promotional positioning, whereas 销售 focuses on the transaction and distribution execution.
倾销 specifically denotes predatory trade dumping at below-market costs abroad, while 销售 is standard commercial trade.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has water radical 氵 on left instead of metal 钅 in 销
Has stone radical 石 on left of 肖
Has four dots 灬 at bottom of 隹 instead of 口 in 售
Has tree radical 木 at bottom of 隹

senses.definition_en: to market, sell, and distribute goods or commercial services to buyers in exchange for money
senses.definition_es: poner a la venta, traspasar y despachar mercancías o servicios a compradores a cambio de un precio

senses.definition_en: the department, volume, or business operations concerning commercial selling and distribution
senses.definition_es: el departamento, volumen o actividad general concerniente a las transacciones de venta
senses.example_phrase: 销售总额 (total sales volume / gross sales)

example_sentences.hanzi: 微信通过打通移动社交生态与线上电子商务闭环，有力推动了中小商家海外销售额的翻倍增长。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wēixìn tōngguò dǎtōng yídòng shèjiāo shēngtài yǔ xiànshàng diànzǐ shāngwù bìhuán, yǒulì tuīdòngle zhōng-xiǎo shāngjiā hǎiwài xiāoshòu'é de fānbèi zēngzhǎng.
example_sentences.en: By connecting mobile social ecosystems with closed-loop online e-commerce, WeChat vigorously boosted the doubling of overseas sales for small merchants.
example_sentences.es: Al integrar redes móviles y comercio electrónico, WeChat impulsó una duplicación en las ventas exteriores de pequeños comerciantes.

example_sentences.hanzi: 由于产品外观设计新颖且性价比极高，这款智能手机在海外市场上市首周便打破了历史销售纪录。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú chǎnpǐn wàiguān shèjì xīnyǐng qiě xìngjiàbǐ jí gāo, zhè kuǎn zhìnéng shǒujī zài hǎiwài shìchǎng shàngshì shǒuzhōu biàn dǎpòle lìshǐ xiāoshòu jìlù.
example_sentences.en: Because of its novel exterior design and superb cost-performance ratio, this smartphone shattered historical sales records during its debut week overseas.
example_sentences.es: Gracias a su diseño vanguardista y su magnífica relación calidad-precio, este móvil pulverizó marcas de ventas en su debut internacional.

idioms.meaning_en: sell briskly without flagging; enduring bestseller
demand exceeds supply; sold out immediately
brisk and prosperous buying and selling
courtyard bustling like a crowded market with customers

character_decomposition.meaning_es: fundir metal; cancelar; disipar; vender; despachar
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 钅 (precious metal / bronze coins) + 肖 (resemble / small particles)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Melting metal 钅 in a foundry so it flows away like small particles 肖; extended to goods melting away briskly in trade like flowing coins.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Melting shining bronze metal (钅) down into flowing currency that circulates in trade (销).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Fundir metal brillante (钅) en moneda fluyente que circula con agilidad en el mercado (销).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 隹 (short-tailed bird / valuable pheasant) + 口 (mouth bargaining in marketplace)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Holding up a prized captured bird 隹 in the market and using one's mouth 口 to bargain prices; selling merchandise.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Holding up a rare bird (隹) while crying out with a lively mouth (口) to sell to customers (售).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Alzar una preciada ave (隹) pregonando a viva voz (口) para cerrar la venta (售).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着全球数字贸易的迅猛崛起，跨国跨境电商平台正在深刻重塑传统外贸销售格局。借助海外前置智能仓储与高效的航空冷链物流网络，过去需要数周乃至数月的跨洋商品销售配送，如今在几天之内即可顺利送达消费者手中。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiú shùzì màoyì de xùnměng juéqǐ, kuàguó kuàjìng diànshāng píngtái zhèng shēnkè zhòngsù chuántǒng wàimào xiāoshòu gégú. Jièzhù hǎiwài qiánzhì zhìnéng cāngchǔ yǔ gāoxiào de hángkōng lěngliàn wùliú wǎngluò, guòqù xūyào shù zhōu nǎizhì shù yuè de kuàyáng shāngpǐn xiāoshòu pèisòng, rújīn zài jǐ tiān zhīnèi jíkě shùnlì sòngdá xiāofèizhě shǒuzhōng.
extended_reading_passages.en: With the rise of digital trade, cross-border e-commerce platforms are restructuring foreign trade sales patterns. Leveraging overseas smart warehouses and cold-chain logistics, transoceanic deliveries that once took months now arrive within days.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el comercio digital en alza, las plataformas transfronterizas reconfiguran las ventas exteriores. Apoyándose en almacenes inteligentes y transporte aéreo frigorífico, envíos que antes tardaban meses se entregan hoy en pocos días.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 新能源汽车制造厂商通过在各大都市核心商圈开设直营体验中心，打破了传统经销商中介销售模式。消费者不仅能在优雅舒适的环境中零距离体验前沿智能座舱科技，还能通过手机软件自主定制配置并一键下单，开创了透明高效的直销新生态。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xīnnéngyuán qìchē zhìzào chǎngshāng tōngguò zài gè dà dūshì héxīn shāngquān kāishè zhíyíng tǐyàn zhōngxīn, dǎpòle chuántǒng jīngxiāoshāng zhōngjiè xiāoshòu móshì. Xiāofèizhě bùjǐn néng zài yōuyǎ shūshì de huánjìng zhōng língjùlí tǐyàn qiányán zhìnéng zuòcāng kējì, hái néng tōngguò shǒujī ruǎnjiàn zìzhǔ dìngzhì pèizhì bìng yíjiàn xiàdān, kāichuàngle tòumíng gāoxiào de zhíxiāo xīn shēngtài.
extended_reading_passages.en: Automakers establish direct experience stores in urban shopping hubs, disrupting traditional dealership models. Consumers experience smart cockpit tech up close, customizing features and ordering via apps in a transparent direct-sales ecosystem.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los fabricantes de vehículos eléctricos abren centros de experiencia en zonas comerciales clave rompiendo con concesionarios tradicionales. Los usuarios prueban la tecnología del habitáculo y configuran su compra desde el móvil con total transparencia.

meanings_summary.en: to target; be directed against; in response to; be aimed at
meanings_summary.es: dirigirse a; apuntar a; en respuesta a; enfocado a; contra (orientado específicamente)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Aiming a sharp needle point (针) directly facing the bullseye mark (对) is targeting purposefully (针对).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Apuntar la punta de la aguja (针) encarando de lleno el blanco (对) es dirigirse o enfocar con precisión (针对).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Derived from classical acupuncture (针灸辨证): inserting the silver needle (针) directly against (对) the specific afflicted meridian node to restore balance.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone followed by fourth tone: 'zhēn duì' (55-51). Hold high pitch 55, then execute a sharp decisive fall to 51.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 针对 indicates purposeful targeting toward a specific problem, situation, or audience group to deliver customized solutions.

contrasts.analysis: 面向 indicates broad orientation, audience catering, or outward perspective ('面向未来', '面向大众'), whereas 针对 emphasizes pointed, problem-solving specificity.
鉴于 is a formal causative preposition meaning 'in light of' or 'considering that' ('鉴于目前局势'), while 针对 emphasizes target focus.
指向 highlights physical or metaphorical directional pointing of an arrow or spearhead ('指向南方'), while 针对 is strategic targeting.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 勺 on right of 钅 instead of 十 in 针
Has 丁 on right of 钅
Has wood 木 on left of 对 in 树
Has 圭 on left of 寸 instead of 又 in 对

senses.definition_en: in connection with; in view of; directed toward a specific circumstance, group, or problem
senses.definition_es: en vista de; con relación a; enfocado directamente hacia un problema, situación o grupo concreto
senses.example_phrase: 针对这一问题 (in response to this problem)

senses.definition_en: to focus or aim specifically at a particular demographic, target market, or condition
senses.definition_es: tener como blanco u objeto específico a un determinado sector o condición
senses.example_phrase: 针对年轻消费者 (targeted at young consumers)

example_sentences.hanzi: 微信针对海外不同国家用户的语言习惯与使用痛点，专门推出了多语种界面与跨境网络优化方案。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wēixìn zhēnduì hǎiwài bùtóng guójiā yònghù de yǔyán xíguàn yǔ shǐyòng tòngdiǎn, zhuānmén tuīchūle duōyǔyán jièmiàn yǔ kuàjìng wǎngluò yōuhuà fāng'àn.
example_sentences.en: Targeting language habits and pain points of users across diverse foreign nations, WeChat specially rolled out multilingual interfaces and cross-border network optimizations.
example_sentences.es: En respuesta a los hábitos lingüísticos de los usuarios internacionales, WeChat lanzó una interfaz multilingüe y mejoras de conectividad exterior.

example_sentences.hanzi: 研发团队针对深海高压与高盐腐蚀的极端恶劣环境，历经多年成功研制出新型钛合金耐压潜水外壳。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yánfā tuánduì zhēnduì shēnhǎi gāoyā yǔ gāoyán fǔshí de jíduān èliè huánjìng, lìjīng duō nián chénggōng yánzhì chū xīnxíng tàihéjīn nàiyā qiánshuǐ wàiké.
example_sentences.en: Targeting the extreme environment of deep-sea high pressure and saline corrosion, the R&D team spent years developing a novel titanium alloy pressure-resistant submersible hull.
example_sentences.es: Para responder a la presión abisal y la corrosión salina, el equipo concibió tras años de ensayos un casco sumergible de aleación de titanio.

collocations.en: in response to the current situation

idioms.meaning_en: prescribe the right remedy for a specific ailment; targeted solution
shoot arrow with clear target in mind; purposeful and targeted
oppose each other with sharp needlepoints; tit for tat
hit the vital spot; touch on the crux of the matter

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 钅 (metal / steel wire) + 十 (crosshairs / sharp target point)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A fine pointed steel metal 钅 wire with an eye; sewing needle or sharp medical acupuncture needle aiming at specific acupoints.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A slender metal wire (钅) ground down to a sharp pinpoint aims directly at the mark (针).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un hilo de metal (钅) afilado hasta formar una punta que apunta con precisión al blanco (针).

character_decomposition.meaning_en: face; direct at; match; correct; toward
character_decomposition.meaning_es: hacia; frente a; correcto; encarar; corresponder
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 又 (hand) + 寸 (ruler / measuring distance)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Two hands facing one another across a measured distance 寸; facing directly, aiming toward, and matching opposites.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two hands measuring exact distance face directly toward one another (对).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos midiendo la distancia exacta se miran y encaran de frente (对).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代精准医学前沿领域，科研人员致力于针对不同患者独特的基因突变类型，量身研发定制专属靶向抗癌药物。这种有的放矢的针对性治疗策略，能够最大限度杀伤肿瘤细胞，同时将对正常人体健康组织的损伤降至最低。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài jīngzhǔn yīxué qiányán lǐngyù, kēyán rényuán zhìlì yú zhēnduì bùtóng huànzhě dútè de jīyīn tūbiàn lèixíng, liàngshēn yánfā dìngzhì zhuānshǔ bǎxiàng kàng'ái yàowù. Zhèzhǒng yǒudì-fàngshǐ de zhēnduìxìng zhìliáo cèlüè, nénggòu zuìdà xiàndù shāshāng zhǒngliú xìbāo, tóngshí jiāng duì zhèngcháng réntǐ jiànkāng zǔzhī de sǔnshāng jiàng zhì zuìdī.
extended_reading_passages.en: In precision medicine, researchers develop targeted cancer drugs tailored to patients' unique gene mutations. This targeted therapeutic strategy maximizes tumor cell destruction while keeping collateral damage to healthy tissues minimal.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la medicina de precisión, los investigadores diseñan fármacos oncológicos dirigidos a mutaciones genéticas específicas de cada paciente. Esta terapia dirigida destruye células tumorales minimizando el daño en tejidos sanos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 为了有效遏制青少年网络游戏沉迷问题，文化主管部门针对未成年人的生理认知特征，出台了严格的实名身份认证与限时防沉迷新规。各大网络平台积极落实相关技术防范措施，为广大家庭筑牢守护未成年人身心健康的数字防线。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wèile yǒuxiào èzhì qīngshàonián wǎngluò yóuxì chénmí wèntí, wénhuà zhǔguǎn bùmén zhēnduì wèichéngniánrén de shēnglǐ rènzhī tèzhēng, chūtáile yángé de shímíng shēnfèn rènzhèng yǔ xiànshí fángchénmí xīnguī. Gè dà wǎngluò píngtái jījí luòshí xiāngguān jìshù fángfàn cuòshī, wèi guǎngdà jiātíng zhùláo shǒuhù wèichéngniánrén shēnxīn jiànkāng de shùzì fángxiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: To curb youth gaming addiction, authorities introduced strict real-name authentication and time-limit regulations targeting minors' cognitive traits. Internet platforms implement technical defenses to safeguard minors' health.
extended_reading_passages.es: Para frenar la adicción a los videojuegos en menores, las autoridades promulgaron normas de autenticación y límites horarios ajustadas a su madurez. Las plataformas reforzaron filtros técnicos protegiendo la salud juvenil.

meanings_summary.en: local; in the locality; indigenous; on site
meanings_summary.es: local; del lugar; autóctono; en la localidad; in situ

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Right at the designated present spot (当) upon that specific plot of earth (地) is the local scene (当地).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Estar en el acto (当) sobre el propio suelo o paraje (地) es ser del lugar o local (当地).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Classical administrative terminology (当时、当地): anchoring judicial rulings and tax levies to the concrete historical time and geographic locality.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: First tone followed by fourth tone: 'dāng dì' (55-51). Hold high pitch 55, then execute a sharp decisive fall to 51.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 当地 designates the specific geographical locality under discussion, often contrasted with foreign, distant, or national levels.

contrasts.analysis: 本地 emphasizes 'this local place' from the speaker's own perspective ('我是本地人' I am a local), while 当地 is objective third-person referring to the place where events occur ('当地居民').
地方 is a broad general noun meaning any physical place or region, or provincial authorities as opposed to central government ('中央与地方').
本土 refers to the homeland or mainland territory of a nation as opposed to overseas colonies ('本土作战', '本土品牌').

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 儿 at bottom instead of 彐 in 当
Has towel 巾 at bottom
Has water radical 氵 on left of 也 instead of earth 土 in 地
Has 𠃓 on right of 土 instead of 也

senses.definition_en: the specific geographical place, locality, or region where an event occurs or where a person resides
senses.definition_es: el lugar o localidad precisa donde sucede un acontecimiento o reside una comunidad

example_sentences.hanzi: 微信在海外推广时，通过签约广受当地民众喜爱的本土体育明星，迅速拉近了与消费者的情感距离。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wēixìn zài hǎiwài tuīguǎng shí, tōngguò qiānyuē guǎngshòu dāngdì mínzhòng xǐ'ài de běntǔ tǐyù míngxīng, xùnsù lājìnle yǔ xiāofèizhě de qínggǎn jùlí.
example_sentences.en: When promoting overseas, WeChat quickly bridged emotional distance with consumers by signing local sports stars widely beloved by local residents.
example_sentences.es: Al promocionarse en el exterior, WeChat acortó distancias fichando a figuras del deporte autóctonas muy queridas por el público local.

example_sentences.hanzi: 旅行者每到一个全新的国度，都应当主动尊重当地的风俗习惯与宗教信仰，以包容的心态体验异域文化。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǚxíngzhě měi dào yī gè quánxīn de guódù, dōu yīngdāng zhǔdòng zūnzhòng dāngdì de fēngsú xíguàn yǔ zōngjiào xìnyǎng, yǐ bāoróng de xīntài tǐyàn yìyù wénhuà.
example_sentences.en: Whenever arriving in a brand-new country, travelers should proactively respect local customs and religious beliefs, experiencing foreign cultures with tolerance.
example_sentences.es: Al llegar a un nuevo país, el viajero debe respetar los usos y credos locales con espíritu tolerante para empaparse de la cultura autóctona.

idioms.meaning_en: when entering a village, follow its customs; do as the Romans do
adapt measures to local conditions; take suited actions
born and bred locally; native born
attached to one's native soil and reluctant to move away

character_decomposition.meaning_en: ought; equal; match; just at (time/place); serve as
character_decomposition.meaning_es: deber; corresponder; justo en; ejercer de; en el acto
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 尚 (lofty banner / value) + 田 (field / land of value)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Value of land 田 matched equally against price 尚; indicates being right on site, corresponding directly to the present time or place.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Marking an exact value directly on the designated plot of land (当).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Fijar un justo valor sobre la parcela concreta señalando el lugar presente (当).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 土 (soil mounds) + 也 (yielding expanse of terrain)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Mounds of earth 土 spreading across receptive expanses 也; indicates place, location, region, and ground.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Mounds of fertile soil (土) defining a distinct regional place (地).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La tierra fértil (土) que delimita una comarca o lugar geográfico (地).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 跨国企业在海外开展投资建设时，必须高度重视与当地社会的良性互动。主动招募培训当地劳动力、积极参与当地教育医疗公益事业，不仅能够有效化解文化摩擦与隔阂，更能为企业的长期稳健经营赢得深厚的民间土壤。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Kuàguó qǐyè zài hǎiwài kāizhǎn tóuzī jiànshè shí, bìxū gāodù zhòngshì yǔ dāngdì shèhuì de liángxìng hùdòng. Zhǔdòng zhāomù péixùn dāngdì láodònglì, jījí cānyù dāngdì jiàoyù yīliáo gōngyì shìyè, bùjǐn nénggòu yǒuxiào huàjiě wénhuà mócā yǔ géhé, gèng néng wèi qǐyè de chángqī wěnjiàn jīngyíng yíngdé shēnhòu de mínjiān tǔrǎng.
extended_reading_passages.en: When investing overseas, multinationals must foster healthy interaction with the local community. Recruiting and training local labor and participating in education charity smooths cultural frictions, cultivating popular goodwill for corporate longevity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al invertir en el exterior, las multinacionales deben estrechar lazos con la sociedad local. Contratar mano de obra autóctona e invertir en educación suaviza fricciones culturales ganándose el aprecio de la comunidad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 漫步在云南边陲的古老村寨中，扑面而来的是极其淳朴浓郁的当地民族风情。村民们身着五彩斑斓的手工刺绣服饰，热情地邀请远道而来的中外游客品尝当地特制的竹筒饭与山泉香茗，在欢歌笑语中体验天人合一的原生态民俗文化。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mànbù zài Yúnnán biānchuí de gǔlǎo cūnzhài zhōng, pūmiàn'érlái de shì jíqí chúnpǔ nóngyù de dāngdì mínzú fēngqíng. Cūnmínmen shēnzhe wǔcǎi-bānlán de shǒugōng cìxiù fúshì, rèqíng de yāoqǐng yuǎndào'érlái de zhōng-wài yóukè pǐncháng dāngdì tèzhì de zhútǒngfàn yǔ shānquán xiāngmíng, zài huāngē-xiàoyǔ zhōng tǐyàn tiānrén-héyī de yuánshēngtài mínsú wénhuà.
extended_reading_passages.en: Strolling through ancient Yunnan border villages, visitors are greeted by rustic local ethnic charm. Villagers in colorful embroidered attire invite guests to taste local bamboo rice and mountain tea, sharing authentic folklore in song and laughter.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al pasear por aldeas fronterizas de Yunnan, el viajero se sumerge en el rico tipismo local. Vestidos con bordados multicolores, los aldeanos convidan a degustar arroz en bambú y té de manantial compartiendo cantos y danzas ancestrales.

meanings_summary.en: to speak on behalf of; endorse (a brand/product); act as spokesperson
meanings_summary.es: hacer de portavoz; prestar la imagen; patrocinar; ser imagen publicitaria de una marca

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Standing in as an official substitute (代) to utter spoken declarations (言) is acting as spokesperson or endorser (代言).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Actuar en lugar de otro (代) pronunciando palabras públicas (言) es hacer de portavoz o prestar la imagen (代言).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Historically, ancient court heralds spoke for the sovereign (为天子代言). In modern marketing, extended to celebrities lending their credibility to commercial brands (代言人).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Fourth tone followed by second tone: 'dài yán' (51-35). Crisp falling 51 tone gliding immediately up to rising 35.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 代言 indicates serving as the public face or official spokesperson for a commercial brand, social movement, or organization.

contrasts.analysis: 代表 is a broad political, legal, or demographic term meaning to represent a constituency, class, or entity ('人民代表'), whereas 代言 specifically focuses on public vocal advocacy or commercial celebrity endorsement.
宣传 is the general act of spreading information or publicity materials, whereas 代言 specifically links an individual's personal image to the brand.
推荐 means casually or professionally recommending a book, friend, or candidate to someone ('推荐一本好书'), without a formal contractual endorsement.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has halberd 戈 on right of 亻 instead of 弋 in 代
Has 匕 on right of 亻
Has person radical 亻 on left of 言 in 信
Has 折 over 言

senses.definition_en: to publicly speak on behalf of an organization, or to endorse a commercial brand as a celebrity ambassador
senses.definition_es: hablar en representación de una entidad o prestar la imagen pública para promocionar una marca comercial
senses.example_phrase: 代言知名品牌 (endorse a renowned brand)

example_sentences.hanzi: 微信签约足坛超级明星梅西作为其全球品牌形象代言人，这在海外引发了轰动性的传播效应。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wēixìn qiānyuē zútán chāojí míngxīng Méixī zuòwéi qí quánqiú pǐnpái xíngxiàng dàiyánrén, zhè zài hǎiwài yǐnfāle hōngdòngxìng de chuánbō xiàoyìng.
example_sentences.en: WeChat signed football superstar Messi as its global brand ambassador, which sparked a sensational promotional effect overseas.
example_sentences.es: WeChat fichó a la superestrella del fútbol Messi como embajador de marca global, causando un impacto mediático formidable en ultramar.

example_sentences.hanzi: 作为深受年轻一代喜爱的杰出青年代表，她积极为联合国的多项环保公益倡议倾情代言。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi shēnshòu niánqīng yídài xǐ'ài de jiéchū qīngnián dàibiǎo, tā jījí wèi Liánhéguó de duō xiàng huánbǎo gōngyì chàngyì qīngqíng dàiyán.
example_sentences.en: As an outstanding youth representative beloved by the younger generation, she enthusiastically speaks on behalf of various UN eco-charity initiatives.
example_sentences.es: Como joven destacada muy admirada por su generación, presta activamente su voz e imagen a iniciativas medioambientales de la ONU.

collocations.en: speak on behalf of public welfare

idioms.meaning_en: speak on behalf of the era and establish immortal words
words are the genuine voice of the inner heart
public opinion melts even gold; power of collective voice
fitting in title and justified in speech; completely legitimate

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 亻 (person stepping forward) + 弋 (wooden stake / shoot with arrow/cord)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A person 亻 standing in as substitute for another to plant a stake 弋; represents representing, substituting, or generations.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A reliable person (亻) stepping forward to hold the banner stake (弋) on another's behalf represents them (代).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona leal (亻) que empuña la estaca (弋) en lugar de otro asume su representación (代).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 口 (human mouth) + 辛/䇂 (flute reeds or sounding tongue projecting notes)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Breath and sounds projecting upward from an open human mouth 口; represents articulated human speech, declarations, and words.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Clear soundwaves rising upward from an open mouth (口) formulate words and speech (言).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ondas sonoras que brotan nítidas desde la boca abierta (口) dando forma a las palabras (言).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代商业广告营销策略中，挑选高度契合品牌核心调性的明星代言人至关重要。一位形象健康阳光、作风低调扎实的体育明星代言，不仅能够显著提升海外消费者的信任感，更能为品牌注入拼搏进取的鲜明人格魅力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài shāngyè guǎnggào yíngxiāo cèlüè zhōng, tiāoxuǎn gāodù qìhé pǐnpái héxīn diàoxìng de míngxīng dàiyánrén zhìguān zhòngyào. Yī wèi xíngxiàng jiànkāng yángguāng, zuòfēng dīdiào zhāshi de tǐyù míngxīng dàiyán, bùjǐn nénggòu xiǎnzhù tíshēng hǎiwài xiāofèizhě de xìnlàigǎn, gèng néng wèi pǐnpái zhùrù pīnbó jìnqǔ de xiānmíng réngé mèilì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In marketing strategy, selecting an ambassador aligned with the brand's core identity is paramount. An energetic, disciplined sports star's endorsement builds consumer trust abroad while infusing the brand with an inspiring fighting spirit.
extended_reading_passages.es: En mercadotecnia publicitaria, elegir un embajador en sintonía con la marca es crucial. El patrocinio de un deportista modélico afianza la confianza del consumidor en el exterior insuflándole un carisma de superación.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 作为当红公众人物，文体明星在接受商业代言时应当严守法律与社会道德规范。在签约之前必须对所代言产品的真实品质展开细致核查，绝不能因诱人的商业代言酬劳而误导广大消费者，切实捍卫自身的社会信誉与职业操守。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zuòwéi dānghóng gōngzhòng rénwù, wéntǐ míngxīng zài jiēshòu shāngyè dàiyán shí yīngdāng yánshǒu fǎlǜ yǔ shèhuì dàodé guīfàn. Zài qiānyuē zhīqián bìxū duì suǒ dàiyán chǎnpǐn de zhēnshí pǐnzhì zhǎnkāi xìzhì héchá, juébù néng yīn yòurén de shāngyè dàiyán chóuláo ér wùdǎo guǎngdà xiāofèizhě, qièshí hànwèi zìshēn de shèhuì xìnyù yǔ zhíyè cāoshǒu.
extended_reading_passages.en: As public figures, entertainment stars must observe legal and ethical norms when accepting endorsements. Meticulously verifying product quality before signing avoids misleading consumers, safeguarding social reputation and professional integrity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Como figuras públicas, los artistas y atletas deben acatar la ética al aceptar contratos publicitarios. Comprobar la calidad real del producto antes de firmar previene engaños al consumidor protegiendo el honor profesional propio.

meanings_summary.en: person of Chinese descent; ethnic Chinese holding foreign nationality
meanings_summary.es: descendiente de chinos; persona de ascendencia china nacida o nacionalizada en el extranjero

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The trailing generational descendants (裔) of the grand Chinese culture (华) living across the world are the ethnic Chinese diaspora (华裔).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Los descendientes lejanos (裔) de la cultura china (华) repartidos por el mundo son los ciudadanos de origen chino (华裔).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Distinction in international law and sociology: 华侨 holds Chinese citizenship while living abroad; 华裔 holds foreign nationality while carrying Chinese heritage.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Second tone followed by fourth tone: 'huá yì' (35-51). Rising second tone followed by brisk decisive drop to 51.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 华裔 designates individuals of Chinese lineage who hold foreign nationality or were born in foreign countries.

contrasts.analysis: 华侨 specifically refers to Chinese citizens who reside abroad while retaining PRC citizenship, whereas 华裔 refers to foreign citizens of Chinese ethnic ancestry.
华人 is a broad cultural/ethnic term embracing all Chinese people globally regardless of citizenship, whereas 华裔 emphasizes ancestral lineage in foreign countries.
后代 is a generic term for biological descendants of any person or animal, whereas 华裔 specifically relates to Chinese ethnicity.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 比 at top instead of 化 in 华
Has person radical 亻 on left of 弋
Has 冂 and 口 inside instead of 衣 in 裔
Has 𢦏 on outside around 衣

senses.definition_en: a person of Chinese ancestral lineage who holds foreign citizenship or was born and raised abroad
senses.definition_es: persona de linaje u origen étnico chino que ostenta nacionalidad extranjera o ha crecido fuera de China
senses.example_phrase: 华裔科学家 (scientist of Chinese descent)

example_sentences.hanzi: 微信最初在海外迅速传播的阶段，海外华人与广大华裔群体成为了第一批最热情的忠实种子用户。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wēixìn zuìchū zài hǎiwài xùnsù chuánbō de jiēduàn, hǎiwài Huárén yǔ guǎngdà Huáyì qúntǐ chéngwéile dì-yī pī zuì rèqíng de zhōngshí zhǒngzǐ yònghù.
example_sentences.en: During the initial phase of WeChat's rapid overseas spread, overseas Chinese and the broad ethnic Chinese diaspora served as the first batch of enthusiastic seed users.
example_sentences.es: En la primera fase de expansión de WeChat en el exterior, los chinos residentes y la comunidad de ascendencia china fueron los usuarios pioneros más fieles.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这位出生于旧金山的年轻华裔建筑师，巧妙地将中国古典园林飞檐美学融入了现代摩天大楼设计之中。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi chūshēng yú Jiùjīnshān de niánqīng Huáyì jiànzhùshī, qiǎomiào de jiāng Zhōngguó gǔdiǎn yuánlín fēiyán měixué róngrùle xiàndài mótiān-dàlóu shèjì zhīzhōng.
example_sentences.en: This young architect of Chinese descent born in San Francisco ingeniously integrated the upturned-eaves aesthetics of classical Chinese gardens into modern skyscraper design.
example_sentences.es: Este joven arquitecto de origen chino nacido en San Francisco integró con ingenio los aleros curvados tradicionales en el diseño de rascacielos vanguardistas.

idioms.meaning_en: fallen leaves return to their roots; return to ancestral homeland
roots run deep and flow from distant antiquity
sharing the exact same lineage and ancestral origin
the four seas belong to one grand human family

character_decomposition.meaning_component: A tree crowned with blooming flowers and luxuriant foliage; simplified from 華
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: A tree bearing radiant blossoming flowers; historically adopted as the proud name for the civilized Chinese nation (华夏).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A luxuriant tree blooming with splendid flowers symbolizes the grand Chinese culture (华).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un árbol floreciente de ramaje resplandeciente que encarna la brillante civilización china (华).

character_decomposition.meaning_en: descendants; offspring; hem of garment; border
character_decomposition.meaning_es: descendientes; prole; estirpe; orla de la túnica; confín
character_decomposition.meaning_component: 衣 (flowing lower garment/hem) + 冏/谷 (valley opening / generational lineage)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: The trailing hem 衣 of an ancestral ceremonial robe that reaches to the ground; represents successive generations of offspring and descendants.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The flowing hem of an ancestral silk robe (衣) extending generation after generation of descendants (裔).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La orla de la túnica ceremonial (衣) que se extiende generación tras generación de descendientes (裔).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着全球文化交流日益频繁，各地的华裔青年正发挥着重要的桥梁作用。他们既深度融入所在国的主流社会，又对祖籍国的历史文化保持着认同感，成为连接中外友好的使者。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiú wénhuà jiāoliú rìyì pínfán, gèdì de Huáyì qīngnián zhèng fāhuī zhe zhòngyào de qiáoliáng zuòyòng. Tāmen jì shēndù róngrù suǒzàiguó de zhǔliú shèhuì, yòu duì zǔjíguó de lìshǐ wénhuà bǎochí zhe rèntónggǎn, chéngwéi liánjiē zhōng-wài yǒuhǎo de shǐzhě.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid frequent cultural exchanges, youth of Chinese descent serve as vital bridges. Fully integrated into host societies, they maintain affinity with ancestral culture, acting as envoys of goodwill.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el intercambio cultural al alza, las jóvenes generaciones de ascendencia china actúan como puentes. Integrados en sus países de adopción, conservan un lazo con sus raíces siendo embajadores de entendimiento.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代科学技术与高等教育领域，一大批杰出的华裔科学家凭借严谨求实的治学精神与卓越非凡的科研成果，屡获诺贝尔奖与图灵奖等国际学术顶级桂冠。他们的杰出贡献不仅为海外华裔赢得了崇高赞誉，更极大地推动了人类科技文明的进步。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài kēxué jìshù yǔ gāoděng jiàoyù lǐngyù, yí dà pī jiéchū de Huáyì kēxuéjiā píngjiè yánjǐn qiúshí de zhìxué jīngshén yǔ zhuóyuè fēifán de kēyán chéngguǒ, lǚ huò Nuòbèi'ěr jiǎng yǔ Túlíng jiǎng děng guójì xuéshù dǐngjí guìguān. Tāmen de jiéchū gòngxiàn bùjǐn wèi hǎiwài Huáyì yíngdéle chónggāo zànyù, gèng jídà de tuīdòngle rénlèi kējì wénmíng de jìnbù.
extended_reading_passages.en: In science and academia, eminent scientists of Chinese descent have garnered Nobel and Turing prizes through rigorous scholarship. Their contributions win acclaim for the diaspora while powerfully advancing human civilization.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la ciencia contemporánea, insignes investigadores de origen chino cosechan premios Nobel y Turing con su rigor metódico. Sus aportaciones prestigian a la comunidad en ultramar impulsando el progreso de la civilización humana.

meanings_summary.en: immigrant; to immigrate; emigrate; migration; resettlement
meanings_summary.es: inmigrante; emigrante; inmigrar; emigrar; reasentamiento de población

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Relocating and transplanting like seedlings (移) the common citizens and people (民) to another land is migration (移民).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Trasladar de tierra (移) a los ciudadanos o población (民) para afincarse es la migración o inmigrante (移民).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Historic policies of frontier state resettlement (移民实边): emperors moving hundreds of thousands of farming households to border garrisons to develop wasteland and secure peace.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two rising second tones: 'yí mín' (35-35). Rise cleanly across both syllables smoothly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 移民 encompasses both the act of international relocation/resettlement and the individuals who settle abroad.

contrasts.analysis: 难民 specifically denotes refugees fleeing war, persecution, or environmental catastrophes, while 移民 is voluntary or legal demographic relocation.
侨民 refers to citizens living in a foreign country who still retain their homeland citizenship, while 移民 frequently involves acquiring foreign permanent residency or citizenship.
居民 simply denotes residents living in a specific neighborhood or city, regardless of ancestry or migration history.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has fire 火 on right of 禾 instead of 多 in 移
Has 厶 on right of 禾
Lacks the closed box-like stroke on top right of 民
Has 亡 over 民

senses.definition_en: to move and settle permanently in another country or region
senses.definition_es: trasladarse para afincar la residencia permanente en otro país o región

senses.definition_en: a person who migrates to another country or region to establish permanent residency
senses.definition_es: persona que se traslada a otro país para establecer en él su residencia definitiva

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了方便与远在大洋彼岸的故乡亲人视频通话，许多定居海外多年的老移民纷纷学会了使用微信。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile fāngbiàn yǔ yuǎn zài dàyáng bǐ'àn de gùxiāng qīnrén shìpín tōnghuà, xǔduō dìngjū hǎiwài duō nián de lǎo yímín fēnfēn xuéhuìle shǐyòng Wēixìn.
example_sentences.en: To conveniently make video calls with relatives far across the ocean back home, many veteran immigrants settled abroad learned to use WeChat.
example_sentences.es: Para conversar por vídeo con sus parientes al otro lado del océano, veteranos emigrantes afincados en el exterior aprendieron a usar WeChat.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这座国际化大都市在过去半个世纪中接纳了数百万来自世界各地的移民，形成了多元包容的文化风貌。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè zuò guójìhuà dàdūshì zài guòqù bàn gè shìjì zhōng jiēnàle shùbǎiwàn láizì shìjiè gèdì de yímín, xíngchéngle duōyuán bāoróng de wénhuà fēngmào.
example_sentences.en: Over the past half-century, this international metropolis has welcomed millions of immigrants from across the globe, forging a diverse and inclusive cultural landscape.
example_sentences.es: A lo largo del último medio siglo, esta metrópolis cosmopolita acogió a millones de inmigrantes de todo el mundo conformando un mosaico multicultural.

idioms.meaning_en: attached to one's native land and loath to move
displaced and wandering without a roof; destitute
when entering a village, adapt to local customs
settle down and establish a home in a new place

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 禾 (young grain shoots) + 多 (many / multiple steps)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Transplanting multiple green rice seedlings 禾 from nursery beds to open wide fields; moving location, shifting, and resettling.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Transplanting delicate rice shoots (禾) from nursery plots to new soil shifts location (移).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trasplantar brotes tiernos de cereal (禾) hacia un nuevo suelo desplaza el asentamiento (移).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: An eye pierced with an ancient tattooing needle or needle sign; historical subjects
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictograph of the common populace or subjects governed beneath heaven; the mass of people and citizens.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A multitude of ordinary people standing firmly together as the foundation of the nation (民).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La multitud de gentes y ciudadanos que componen los cimientos de la comunidad (民).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在近代波澜壮阔的跨洋大迁徙历史中，“下南洋”成为了中国东南沿海无数家庭改变命运的艰难选择。成千上万的早期移民凭借一把汗水与坚韧不拔的吃苦精神，在异国他乡开荒经商，为当地经济繁荣打下了不可磨灭的坚实功绩。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài jìndài bōlán-zhuàngkuò de kuàyáng dà qiānxǐ lìshǐ zhōng, 'xià nányáng' chéngwéile Zhōngguó dōngnán yánhǎi wúshù jiātíng gǎibiàn mìngyùn de jiānnán xuǎnzé. Chéngqiān-shàngwàn de zǎoqī yímín píngjiè yī bǎ hànshuǐ yǔ jiānrèn-bùbá de chīkǔ jīngshén, zài yìguó tāxiāng kāihuāng jīngshāng, wèi dāngdì jīngjì fánróng dǎxiàle bùkě-mómè de jiānshí gōngjì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In transoceanic migration history, venturing to Southeast Asia became a fateful choice for coastal families. Thousands of early immigrants, relying on toil and perseverance, cleared land and ran businesses, leaving an indelible mark on local prosperity.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la migración transoceánica, marchar al Sudeste Asiático fue una ardua senda para familias del litoral. Miles de pioneros, con tesón y sudor, roturaron tierras y abrieron comercios en el extranjero dejando una huella perenne.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着全球经济一体化与跨国人才流动的不断深化，许多国家纷纷出台了极具吸引力的技术移民政策。通过为海外高层次科学、工程与金融创新人才开辟绿色签证通道，不仅有效缓解了本国老龄化社会的劳动力短缺，更为知识经济注入了蓬勃的新鲜血液。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe quánqiú jīngjì yītǐhuà yǔ kuàguó réncái liúdòng de bùduàn shēnhuà, xǔduō guójiā fēnfēn chūtáile jíjù xīyǐnlì de jìshù yímín zhèngcè. Tōngguò wèi hǎiwài gāocéngcì kēxué, gōngchéng yǔ jīnróng chuàngxīn réncái kāipì lǜsè qiānzhèng tōngdào, bùjǐn yǒuxiào huǎnjiěle běnguó lǎolínghuà shèhuì de láodònglì duǎnquē, gèng wèi zhīshi jīngjì zhùrùle péngbó de xīnxiān xuèyè.
extended_reading_passages.en: With globalization, many nations formulate skilled immigration policies. Opening green visa channels for overseas scientists, engineers, and financiers eases labor shortages from aging while injecting fresh blood into knowledge economies.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con la globalización, muchos países promulgan políticas de inmigración cualificada. Abrir visados rápidos a científicos y tecnólogos alivia el envejecimiento demográfico insuflándole savia nueva a la economía del conocimiento.
